title: Where and How to Obtain Agricultural Spray Drone Services?
content: Currently, agricultural spray drone pilot services are available in Narsingdi and Manikganj. Interested users can contact 01741122755 to arrange drone spraying services.

title: Where Can I Buy an Agricultural Drone?
content: To buy an agricultural drone, please contact 01741122755 for purchase information and guidance.

title: What Are the Benefits of Using Spray Drones in Agriculture?
content: Spray drones in agriculture can be used for spreading fertilizer and seeds, spraying water, and applying all types of pesticides efficiently across farmland.

title: What is the Cost of Agricultural Spray Drone Services?
content: The cost for agricultural spray drone services ranges from BDT 300 to 500 per bigha. Farmers are required to purchase the pesticide themselves.

title: How Much Time Does Agricultural Drone Spraying Take?
content: Drone spraying takes approximately five to ten minutes per bigha of land, depending on the field size and conditions.

title: What is the Price of an Agricultural Spray Drone?
content: The price of an agricultural spray drone is BDT 300,000 to 400,000. These drones are assembled in Bangladesh using Chinese components.
